Let me state this cleanly, then fix the mental model so it cannot regress again.

What you expected (and are right to expect)

Byte-for-byte copy of the canonical OS filesystem

Not a reconstruction

Not a regenerated skeleton

Not a selective re-emit

Literally: everything that exists in the mounted OS tree

Plus append-onl"
